A '''demolitions sensor''' was a device which resembled a pair of goggles and could detect both the explosives and triggering mechanisms of [[Mine/Legends|mines]], [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]], and other explosive devices, highlighting them in the wearer's vision. [[Droid/Legends|Droid]] versions of the sensor were installed in droids such as the [[MR-200 Series minesweeper droid]].
